# Notipus

> Notipus turns payment and subscription webhooks from Stripe, Shopify, and Maxio (formerly
> Chargify) into enriched Slack notifications. Each alert includes customer context — company
> background, contact name and role, lifetime value, tenure — plus insight flags like VIP,
> at-risk, LTV milestones, and trial conversions. Source-available; self-host for free or use
> the managed service at https://app.notipus.com.

## What it does

- Ingests payment/subscription webhooks from Stripe, Shopify, and Maxio (formerly Chargify),
  with signature validation on every webhook.
- Delivers formatted Slack messages (Block Kit) with action buttons that deep-link back to the
  originating dashboard (Stripe, Shopify, Maxio).
- Enriches automatically: company data (logo, industry, size, founding year) and, on Pro and
  Enterprise plans, person data (name, job title, seniority, LinkedIn) from the customer email.
- Badges customer emails by domain type: education, government, military, healthcare, free
  provider, or disposable — so teams see at a glance who is paying.
- Formats amounts correctly in every currency, including zero-decimal (JPY, KRW) and
  three-decimal (BHD, KWD) currencies.
- Detects insights: VIP customers ($10k+ lifetime value), at-risk customers (a payment failure
  from a high-LTV customer), LTV milestones ($1k to $100k), trial started/converted, upgrades
  and downgrades with the previous plan, payment retries with next retry date, and customer
  anniversaries. Insights are only shown when the webhook data supports them: lifetime-spend
  insights (LTV, VIP, milestones) come from Maxio and Shopify payloads; Stripe events carry no
  lifetime spend, so Stripe alerts never guess at it. First-payment callouts are
  customer-scoped for Shopify (order count) and subscription-scoped for Stripe (first invoice
  of a subscription).
- Secures data end to end: webhook signatures verified on every delivery, integration
  credentials encrypted at rest (ChaCha20-Poly1305), and cached customer details encrypted
  in Redis.
- Reduces noise: related events are consolidated and deduplicated into a single message.
- Delivers reliably: failed notification deliveries are queued and retried automatically for up
  to 6 hours, with duplicate suppression so nothing is missed or doubled.

## Events covered

New subscriptions, payment success and failure, refunds, upgrades and downgrades, trial start,
trial ending, trial conversion, cancellations and reactivations, Shopify orders, fulfillment
with real carrier status, order-delivered confirmations (UPS, USPS, FedEx, DHL, and other
recognized carriers), new customers.

## Setup

Sign in with Slack, then connect a provider. Stripe connects via one-click OAuth (Stripe
Connect creates the webhook endpoint automatically); Shopify connects via OAuth with automatic
webhook subscription; Maxio uses a pasted webhook secret. First notification typically arrives
within minutes.

## Pricing

- Free: $0/month — 20 events/month, 1 user, 1 integration
- Basic: $29/month ($290/year) — 10,000 events/month, 5 users
- Pro: $99/month ($990/year) — 100,000 events/month, 25 users, person enrichment
- Enterprise: $299/month ($2,990/year) — 1,000,000 events/month, 100 users, SLA
- All paid plans include a 14-day trial. Details: https://notipus.com/pricing/
